name: Longitudinal Section of a Flower (Angiosperm Reproduction)
semanticDescription: Botanical-grade 3D model of a typical bisexual flower with dual presentation collections (Flower_Full and Flower_Section). Features pedicel, green thalamus/receptacle, protective calyx (sepals), vibrant velvety corolla (petals), androecium with slender filaments and bilobed golden anthers displaying microsporangia furrows and pollen dusting, and central gynoecium/pistil with 5-lobed papillate stigma, style, and basal ovary with clean longitudinal cutaway revealing central placenta, funiculi, and bitegmic ovules with female gamete embryo sacs (NCERT Class 10 Biology Ch 8 Figure 8.7).
simplifications: Flower_Section displays anterior petals removed and ovary bisected for pedagogical clarity.
Internal ovules attached via distinct funiculi stalks to highlight angiosperm placentation.

materials.look: Supportive green stalk and swollen floral thalamus base
Velvety colorful floral petals (rosy magenta, roughness 0.38)
Slender pale translucent filaments supporting anthers
Bilobed golden yellow anthers with microsporangia furrows
Golden microspore dusting along theca dehiscence lines
Central reproductive pistil: ovary, style, and 5-lobed sticky stigma
Central placental tissue column inside ovary
Bitegmic ovules attached via funiculi with embryonic egg cell sacs
